text_block_list.text: Trainer! Congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан has been selected to be
Umamusume
of the Year!
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text: ...Umamusume of the Year?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Ah, Brian! Perfect timing! Allow me to
explain.
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
That title is bestowed upon the racer
with the
highest accolades.
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
There is also an award ceremony, so
please
glance through these documents
regarding
attendance.
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm sure the ceremony will be a
huge
milestone for you.
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text: Hey, do we really have to go?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Well, technically, we could skip, but...

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm not a fan of things like this,
and I'd like
to avoid any unnecessary
annoyances.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
The only thing I want to focus on right
now is
running.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...I've heard that strong runners who've
won in the
past will also be in
attendance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that being able to see them up
close and
hear how they think will have
a positive impact on
her running. Not to
mention...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Going will motivate you to get stronger.

text_block_list.text: Mmm...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
That's a hard opportunity to pass up.
Fine then...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It's your duty to make me stronger. I'll
leave it to
you to guide me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
That's the deal I signed up for, so you
won't hear
any complaints from me. Pick
whatever path you
think I need.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
This is an important decision that will
affect her
future. Should we look to rub
shoulders with
seasoned racers... or not?
The best choice is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
You want to face off with the best, so let's
attend!
Maybe it's a little too soon.

text_block_list.text: ...Heh, all right.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Then I'm with you. Let's move to the
arena where
the strongest fight.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...All right.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'm still nothing more than a competitor.
It's too
early for me to move to the next
level.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'm not even sure I understand what
strength is
yet anyway.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
And so, we give notice that Нарита Брайан
will be
attending.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, we give notice that Нарита Брайан
won't be
attending.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
